segments.text: Lesson 17
segments.translation: 第17课

segments.text: A man-made disease
segments.translation: 一种人为疾病

segments.text: Listen to the tape then answer this question.
segments.translation: 听录音，然后回答问题。

segments.text: What factor helped to spread the disease of myxomatosis?
segments.translation: 哪些因素有助于黏液瘤病的传播？

segments.text: In the early days of the settlement of Australia, enterprising settlers unwisely introduced the European rabbit.
segments.translation: 在澳大利亚定居的早期，有进取心的定居者不明智地引入了欧洲兔子。

segments.text: This rabbit had no natural enemies in the Antipodes, so that it multiplied with that promiscuous abandon characteristic of rabbits.
segments.translation: 这只兔子在对脚海峡没有天敌，因此它与兔子杂乱无章的抛弃特征相乘。

segments.text: It overran a whole continent.
segments.translation: 它占领了整个大陆。

segments.text: It caused devastation by burrowing and by devouring the herbage which might have maintained millions of sheep and cattle.
segments.translation: 它通过挖洞和吞噬可能养活数百万羊和牛的牧草造成了破坏。

segments.text: Scientists discovered that this particular variety of rabbit (and apparently no other animal) was susceptible to a fatal virus disease, myxomatosis.
segments.translation: 科学家们发现，这种特殊的兔子（显然没有其他动物）容易感染致命的病毒性疾病，即黏液瘤病。

segments.text: By infecting animals and letting them loose in the burrows, local epidemics of this disease could be created.
segments.translation: 通过感染动物并让它们在洞穴中散开，可以造成这种疾病的局部流行。

segments.text: Later it was found that there was a type of mosquito which acted as the carrier of this disease and passed it on to the rabbits.
segments.translation: 后来发现有一种蚊子充当这种疾病的携带者，并将其传递给兔子。

segments.text: So while the rest of the world was trying to get rid of mosquitoes, Australia was encouraging this one.
segments.translation: 因此，当世界其他地区试图摆脱蚊子的时候，澳大利亚正在鼓励这种蚊子。

segments.text: It effectively spread the disease all over the continent and drastically reduced the rabit population.
segments.translation: 它有效地将疾病传播到整个大陆，并大大减少了兔子的数量。

segments.text: It later became apparent that rabbits were developing a degree of resistance to this disease,
segments.translation: 后来很明显，兔子对这种疾病产生了一定程度的抵抗力，

segments.text: so that the rabbit population was unlikely to be completely exterminated.
segments.translation: 所以兔子种群不太可能被完全消灭

segments.text: There were hopes, however, that the problem of the rabbit would become manageable.
segments.translation: 然而，人们希望兔子的问题能够得到解决。

segments.text: Ironically, Europe, which had bequeathed the rabbit as a pest to Australia, acquired this man-made disease as a pestilence.
segments.translation: 具有讽刺意味的是，将兔子作为害虫遗赠给澳大利亚的欧洲，却以瘟疫的形式获得了这种人为疾病。

segments.text: A French physician decided to get rid of the wild rabbits on his own estate and introduced myxomatosis.
segments.translation: 一位法国医生决定消灭他自己庄园里的野兔，并引入了粘液瘤病。

segments.text: It did not, however, remain within the confines of this estate.
segments.translation: 然而，它并没有留在这个庄园的范围内。

segments.text: It spread through France, where wild rabbits are not generally regarded as a pest but as a sport and a useful food supply,
segments.translation: 它传播到法国，在那里野兔通常不被视为害虫，而是一种运动和有用的食物供应，

segments.text: and it spread to Britain where wild rabbits are regarded as a pest but where domesticated rabbits,
segments.translation: 它传播到了英国，那里的野兔被视为害虫，但那里的家兔，

segments.text: equally susceptible to the disease, are the basis of a profitable fur industry.
segments.translation: 同样容易受到这种疾病的影响，是毛皮工业盈利的基础。

segments.text: The question became one of whether Man could control the disease he had invented.
segments.translation: 问题之一是人类能否控制他发明的疾病。
